In the online A/B test, GenRec showed an **average treatment effect of +0.115%** on the short-term homepage engagement metric, compared with the production model. The **p-value was 3.1 × 10⁻¹⁰**, which the paper labels statistically significant (Figure 3, page 1).

For context, the test used about 10% of Netflix traffic for 4 weeks (page 1).
